world.title: Paraguay's president impeached and under house arrest after bank collapse
world.summary: Santiago Peña, Paraguay's president, has been impeached and placed under house arrest following a severe banking crisis that left millions of citizens unable to access their funds. The financial collapse triggered the political upheaval, demonstrating the serious economic consequences facing the South American nation. This represents a significant political and economic crisis in the region, with widespread implications for Paraguay's financial stability and governance. The banking emergency prompted swift parliamentary action to remove the president from office.
world.title_hi: पैराग्वे के राष्ट्रपति को महाभियोग का सामना करना पड़ा और बैंक संकट के बाद गृह नजरबंदी में रखा गया
world.summary_hi: पैराग्वे के राष्ट्रपति सैंटियागो पेना को महाभियोग लगाया गया है और एक गंभीर बैंकिंग संकट के बाद गृह नजरबंदी में रखा गया है जिसने लाखों नागरिकों को अपने धन तक पहुंचने से रोक दिया है। वित्तीय संकट ने राजनीतिक उथल-पुथल को ट्रिगर किया, जो दक्षिण अमेरिकी राष्ट्र के सामने गंभीर आर्थिक परिणामों को प्रदर्शित करता है। यह क्षेत्र में एक महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक और आर्थिक संकट का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जिसके पैराग्वे की वित्तीय स्थिरता और शासन के लिए व्यापक निहितार्थ हैं। बैंकिंग आपातकाल ने राष्ट्रपति को पद से हटाने के लिए तेजी से संसदीय कार्रवाई को प्रेरित किया।

world.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
world.summary: U.S. President Trump has promoted Stephen Miller, a loyal partisan firebrand, to the position of chief of staff. This appointment signals potential confrontations with Congress, as Miller is known for his combative political approach. The promotion sets the stage for likely clashes between the executive branch and legislative body over policy matters. Miller's appointment reflects Trump's preference for loyal, ideologically aligned advisors in key positions, suggesting an aggressive approach to governance during this administration.
world.title_hi: स्टीफन मिलर की नियुक्ति के साथ, ट्रम्प एक लड़ाई के लिए तैयार हो रहे हैं
world.summary_hi: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने एक वफादार और आक्रामक राजनीतिज्ञ स्टीफन मिलर को मुख्य कर्मचारी के पद पर पदोन्नत किया है। यह नियुक्ति कांग्रेस के साथ संभावित टकराव का संकेत देती है, क्योंकि मिलर अपने आक्रामक राजनीतिक दृष्टिकोण के लिए जाने जाते हैं। यह पदोन्नति कार्यकारी शाखा और विधायी निकाय के बीच नीति मामलों पर संभावित संघर्ष के लिए मंच तैयार करती है। मिलर की नियुक्ति मुख्य पदों पर वफादार, विचारधारा से संरेखित सलाहकारों के लिए ट्रम्प की प्राथमिकता को दर्शाती है, जो इस प्रशासन के दौरान शासन के लिए एक आक्रामक दृष्टिकोण का सुझाव देती है।

world.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
world.summary: Spanish rail authorities are under investigation by European prosecutors following the Urda rail disaster that killed 69 people. The probe focuses on the misuse of European Union funds intended for upgrading the Spanish railway line where the fatal train crash occurred. This investigation represents a significant accountability measure, examining whether EU resources designated for railway safety improvements were properly allocated and utilized. The disaster has prompted scrutiny into both the accident's causes and the management of international funding for infrastructure projects.
world.title_hi: उर्दा रेल आपदा के बाद स्पेन के रेल अधिकारियों को यूरोपीय धोखाधड़ी जांच का सामना करना पड़ रहा है
world.summary_hi: स्पेनिश रेल अधिकारी उर्दा रेल आपदा के बाद यूरोपीय अभियोजकों द्वारा जांच के अंतर्गत हैं जिसमें 69 लोग मारे गए थे। जांच स्पेनिश रेलवे लाइन को अपग्रेड करने के लिए आवंटित यूरोपीय संघ के धन के दुरुपयोग पर केंद्रित है जहां घातक ट्रेन दुर्घटना हुई थी। यह जांच एक महत्वपूर्ण जवाबदेही उपाय का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है, जो यह जांचती है कि क्या रेलवे सुरक्षा सुधार के लिए नामित यूरोपीय संघ के संसाधनों को ठीक से आवंटित और उपयोग किया गया था। आपदा ने दुर्घटना के कारणों और बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं के लिए अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वित्तपोषण के प्रबंधन दोनों में जांच को प्रेरित किया है।

world.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
world.summary: Pope Leo has begun a Latin America tour just three weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. Despite the recent major medical procedure, the pontiff is reported to be in relatively good health as he embarks on this significant international journey. The tour represents an important pastoral mission across the region, demonstrating the Pope's commitment to his duties despite his recent health challenges. His recovery and ability to travel so soon after cancer surgery has been noted as encouraging by Vatican officials and observers.
world.title_hi: पोप 'काफी अच्छे स्वास्थ्य' में हैं जब वे लैटिन अमेरिका दौरा शुरू करते हैं
world.summary_hi: पोप लियो ने फेफड़ों के कैंसर की सर्जरी के तीन सप्ताह बाद लैटिन अमेरिका दौरा शुरू किया है। हाल की प्रमुख चिकित्सा प्रक्रिया के बावजूद, पोंटिफ को इस महत्वपूर्ण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय यात्रा पर निकलते समय अपेक्षाकृत अच्छे स्वास्थ्य में बताया गया है। यह दौरा क्षेत्र में एक महत्वपूर्ण चरवाहा मिशन का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जो हाल की स्वास्थ्य चुनौतियों के बावजूद अपने कर्तव्यों के प्रति पोप की प्रतिबद्धता को प्रदर्शित करता है। कैंसर की सर्जरी के बाद इतनी जल्दी उनकी वसूली और यात्रा करने की क्षमता को वेटिकन अधिकारियों और पर्यवेक्षकों द्वारा प्रोत्साहजनक के रूप में नोट किया गया है।

world.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
world.summary: Paul Mackenzie, a Kenyan doomsday cult leader, has been sentenced to life imprisonment for orchestrating the murders of 191 people. Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest, claiming this would allow them to "meet Jesus." The case represents one of the most severe cult-related mass killings, highlighting the dangers of extremist religious movements and their exploitation of vulnerable followers. The conviction and sentencing mark a significant legal outcome in addressing this tragic humanitarian crisis.
world.title_hi: केन्याई सर्वनाश पंथ के नेता को 191 लोगों की हत्या के लिए आजीवन कारावास दिया गया
world.summary_hi: केन्याई सर्वनाश पंथ के नेता पॉल मैकेंजी को 191 लोगों की हत्या को व्यवस्थित करने के लिए आजीवन कारावास की सजा दी गई है। मैकेंजी ने अपने अनुयायियों को अपने बच्चों को जंगल में भूखे मरने का आदेश दिया, यह दावा करते हुए कि इससे वे 'यीशु से मिल सकेंगे'। यह मामला सबसे गंभीर पंथ-संबंधित सामूहिक हत्याओं में से एक का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जो चरमपंथी धार्मिक आंदोलनों और कमजोर अनुयायियों के उनके शोषण के खतरों को उजागर करता है। सजा और दंड इस त्रासदीपूर्ण मानवीय संकट को संबोधित करने में एक महत्वपूर्ण कानूनी परिणाम को चिह्नित करते हैं।

usa.title: Trump names Stephen Miller as new White House chief of staff
usa.summary: President Donald Trump has appointed Stephen Miller, architect of his hard-line immigration policy, as White House chief of staff, effective Monday. Miller, described as a loyal partisan firebrand, is expected to set up likely clashes with Congress. His promotion signals Trump's continued commitment to aggressive immigration enforcement and suggests potential confrontations with the Democratic-controlled legislature over policy implementation and oversight.

usa.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
usa.summary: The United States is offering a $20 million reward for information regarding Iran's nuclear program. This initiative reflects President Donald Trump's repeated statements about potentially renewing military strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities. The reward program represents an escalation in pressure on Iran and signals the administration's hardline stance on nuclear proliferation concerns in the Middle East region.

usa.title: Dozens of Democrats eyeing 2028 presidential run, says former Obama aide
usa.summary: According to former Obama aide Jim Messina, over two dozen Democratic campaigns are already preparing for the 2028 presidential race following the party's significant midterm victories. Some campaigns have begun hiring staff, indicating serious early preparations. The Democratic gains in Congress this election cycle appear to be energizing multiple potential candidates to position themselves for the next presidential contest.

usa.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
usa.summary: The United States experienced its largest decline in homelessness in over a decade, with the homeless population dropping from record-high levels. However, approximately 700,000 people remain homeless. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups attribute the decrease to different factors, reflecting ongoing debate about the causes and solutions to homelessness in America.

usa.title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
usa.summary: Following Democrats' sweeping electoral victories this week, the party plans to expand investigations into fatal shootings by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents. The deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti during an ICE surge in Minneapolis last winter were pivotal moments that galvanized public attention. With Democratic control of Congress, renewed scrutiny of immigration enforcement practices and agent conduct is expected to intensify.

india.title: Homes and temples glow across India as Diwali celebrations begin
india.summary: Millions of Indians are celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with traditional customs and festivities. The celebration involves lighting glowing lamps, setting off fireworks, and preparing traditional sweets across homes and temples throughout the country. Diwali is one of India's most significant festivals, symbolizing the victory of light over darkness and good over evil. The festival brings communities together in widespread celebrations marked by decorations, family gatherings, and religious observances. This year's Diwali celebrations showcase the cultural continuity and importance of the festival in Indian society.

india.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
india.summary: Delhi faces the return of severe winter air pollution as the season approaches, with air quality reaching dangerous levels. The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan to address the pollution crisis, but environmental experts argue these measures are insufficient to tackle the problem. The capital experiences hazardous air quality during winter months due to factors including vehicle emissions, industrial pollution, and agricultural burning in neighboring states. The recurring pollution crisis poses significant health risks to Delhi's residents, particularly vulnerable populations including children and the elderly. Authorities continue to grapple with finding effective long-term solutions to combat the seasonal air quality deterioration.

india.title: India's costliest film retells a beloved Hindu epic - but divides critics
india.summary: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, Bollywood's most expensive film production to date, has become the year's most anticipated movie release. The film is the first installment of a two-part adaptation of the Hindu epic Ramayana, one of India's most revered religious and cultural texts. Despite significant production investment and widespread anticipation, the film has generated divided critical responses regarding its artistic interpretation and execution. The ambitious project represents a major investment in Indian cinema and reflects Bollywood's efforts to create large-scale adaptations of classical Indian literature. The film's reception highlights ongoing debates within the film industry about how to authentically represent beloved cultural narratives for contemporary audiences.

india.title: 'We grew up around this historic Delhi mosque - now we have been forced out'
india.summary: Authorities in central Delhi have demolished hundreds of residential houses in a neighborhood, claiming the structures were illegally constructed on government land. Long-time residents, many of whom grew up in the area surrounding a historic mosque, have been forcibly displaced from their homes. The demolition campaign has affected entire communities with deep historical and cultural ties to the neighborhood. Residents report emotional distress over losing their homes and displacement from areas where their families have lived for generations. The incident raises concerns about urban development policies, property rights, and the impact of government land reclamation efforts on vulnerable populations in Delhi's historic districts.

india.title: Indians turn to start-ups to care for ageing parents as young become more mobile
india.summary: Changing family structures and increased mobility of younger generations in India are driving demand for eldercare start-ups offering professional services for aging parents. Traditional joint family systems, where multiple generations lived together, are evolving as young Indians migrate for employment and educational opportunities. This demographic shift has created a market gap for innovative eldercare solutions provided by emerging start-ups. These companies offer services designed to support elderly parents whose adult children are geographically dispersed, addressing healthcare, companionship, and daily living assistance needs. The trend reflects broader social transformations in Indian society, including urbanization, changing work patterns, and evolving family dynamics that challenge conventional caregiving arrangements.

odisha.title: Odisha gets 318 additional PG medical seats, total rises to 938
odisha.summary: The National Medical Commission has approved a significant expansion of postgraduate medical education in Odisha, increasing PG medical seats by 318 across five government medical colleges. This expansion raises the total PG seats from 620 to 938, representing a 51% increase in capacity. The move aims to enhance medical education infrastructure and produce more specialized medical professionals in the state, addressing the growing demand for postgraduate medical training and improving healthcare delivery capabilities across Odisha's medical institutions.

odisha.title: Odisha invites scholarship applications under 'Mukhyamantri Medhabi Chhatra Protsahan Yojana' 2026-27
odisha.summary: The Odisha government has opened applications for the Mukhyamantri Medhabi Chhatra Protsahan Yojana scholarship program for the 2026-27 academic year. This merit-based scholarship scheme aims to support talented and deserving students in pursuing higher education. Interested applicants can submit their applications through the official Odisha State Scholarship Portal at scholarship.odisha.gov.in. The initiative reflects the state's commitment to promoting educational excellence and providing financial assistance to meritorious students, helping reduce educational barriers and encouraging academic achievement across the state.

odisha.title: Odisha Plans Drug-Free Zones Within 500 Metres of Schools, Colleges and Universities
odisha.summary: The Odisha government is implementing a comprehensive initiative to establish drug-free zones within a 500-metre radius of all educational institutions, including schools, colleges, universities, and their hostels across the state. This preventive measure aims to protect students from substance abuse and create safer campus environments. The drug-free zone designation will involve strict enforcement and monitoring to prevent drug trafficking and consumption near educational facilities, addressing growing concerns about youth substance abuse and supporting the government's broader public health and safety objectives.

odisha.title: Diwali 2026: Food safety raids across Odisha uncover stale sweets, unhygienic practices
odisha.summary: Food safety inspections conducted across Odisha ahead of Diwali 2026 revealed significant quality concerns regarding sweets sold in markets during the festival season. The raids uncovered instances of stale sweets and unhygienic manufacturing practices among vendors. These findings raised serious public health concerns as citizens traditionally exchange sweets with family and friends during Diwali celebrations. The inspections highlight the need for stricter food safety regulations and vendor compliance to protect consumers from contaminated or substandard food products during major festivals and celebrations.

odisha.title: AI-based model to help scrutinise Odisha pension cases
odisha.summary: Odisha is developing an artificial intelligence-based pension model designed to streamline and improve the examination of pension cases for state government employees. The AI system will verify pay fixation, service-related details, and other critical pension information with greater accuracy and efficiency. This technological initiative aims to accelerate pension processing timelines while reducing errors and ensuring transparency in pension administration. The implementation of AI-driven scrutiny represents the state's effort to modernize administrative processes, enhance service delivery to retired employees, and maintain integrity in pension disbursement systems.

sports.title: Ponga-inspired New Zealand reach World Cup final
sports.summary: New Zealand's rugby league team advanced to their first World Cup final since 2013 after defeating Tonga in a closely contested match. Star player Kalyn Ponga made a remarkable return from a broken arm to inspire the team's victory in this pulsating encounter. The win sets up an exciting final matchup and marks a significant achievement for the New Zealand squad, who will be seeking to claim the world championship title after a 13-year absence from the final stage of the tournament.
sports.title_hi: पोंगा से प्रेरित न्यूजीलैंड विश्व कप फाइनल में पहुंचे
sports.summary_hi: न्यूजीलैंड की रग्बी लीग टीम टोंगा को करीबी मुकाबले में हराकर 2013 के बाद से अपने पहले विश्व कप फाइनल में पहुंच गई है। स्टार खिलाड़ी कलिन पोंगा ने टूटी हुई बांह से शानदार वापसी करके टीम की जीत को प्रेरित किया। यह जीत एक रोमांचक फाइनल मुकाबले की स्थापना करती है और न्यूजीलैंड स्क्वाड के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि है, जो 13 साल की अनुपस्थिति के बाद विश्व चैंपियनशिप का खिताब जीतने का प्रयास करेगी।

sports.title: New Zealand sweep aside Samoa to reach Women's World Cup final
sports.summary: New Zealand's women's rugby league team secured a dominant 32-0 victory over Samoa to reach the World Cup final scheduled for the following Sunday. This commanding performance demonstrates the team's strength and consistency in the tournament. The women's team will be seeking their fourth World Cup title, having previously reached multiple finals. The emphatic nature of their semifinal victory suggests they enter the final as strong contenders to claim the championship trophy.
sports.title_hi: न्यूजीलैंड ने समोआ को हराकर महिला विश्व कप फाइनल में प्रवेश किया
sports.summary_hi: न्यूजीलैंड की महिला रग्बी लीग टीम ने समोआ को 32-0 से शानदार जीत दर्ज करके विश्व कप फाइनल में प्रवेश किया, जो अगले रविवार को निर्धारित है। यह प्रभावशाली प्रदर्शन टूर्नामेंट में टीम की ताकत और निरंतरता को प्रदर्शित करता है। महिला टीम अपना चौथा विश्व कप खिताब जीतने का प्रयास करेगी, जिन्होंने पहले कई फाइनल में पहुंचे हैं। सेमीफाइनल में उनकी शानदार जीत से संकेत मिलता है कि वे चैंपियनशिप ट्रॉफी जीतने के लिए मजबूत दावेदार के रूप में फाइनल में प्रवेश करते हैं।

sports.title: Whole Australia team knew of sandpaper use - Khawaja
sports.summary: Usman Khawaja has made significant allegations regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal involving the Australian cricket team during their Test series against South Africa. Khawaja claims that the entire Australian team was aware of the use of sandpaper to tamper with the ball during the final Test of that series. This revelation adds substantial weight to the controversy and suggests the incident involved broader team knowledge rather than isolated player actions. The allegations raise important questions about team accountability and cricket's integrity standards.
sports.title_hi: पूरी ऑस्ट्रेलियाई टीम को सैंडपेपर के इस्तेमाल का पता था - खवाजा
sports.summary_hi: उस्मान खवाजा ने 2018 की बॉल-टैम्परिंग घोटाले के संबंध में गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं, जो दक्षिण अफ्रीका के खिलाफ ऑस्ट्रेलियाई क्रिकेट टीम की टेस्ट सीरीज के दौरान हुआ था। खवाजा का दावा है कि पूरी ऑस्ट्रेलियाई टीम को उस सीरीज के अंतिम टेस्ट में बॉल को टैम्पर करने के लिए सैंडपेपर के इस्तेमाल के बारे में पता था। यह खुलासा विवाद को काफी वजन देता है और सुझाता है कि यह घटना अलग-थलग खिलाड़ियों की कार्रवाई के बजाय व्यापक टीम ज्ञान में शामिल थी। ये आरोप टीम जवाबदेही और क्रिकेट की अखंडता के मानकों के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण सवाल उठाते हैं।

sports.title: I left Man City for my mental wellbeing - Trafford
sports.summary: Goalkeeper James Trafford has explained his decision to leave Manchester City and join Leeds United in the summer transfer window, citing mental health concerns. Trafford described his experience of not playing for Manchester City during the previous season as "horrendous," indicating the psychological toll of limited playing time at the elite club. His departure highlights the importance of mental wellbeing in professional sports and the challenges players face when competing for positions at top-tier clubs. The move to Leeds represents a fresh start for Trafford's career.
sports.title_hi: मैंने अपनी मानसिक सुस्थता के लिए मैन सिटी छोड़ा - ट्रैफोर्ड
sports.summary_hi: गोलकीपर जेम्स ट्रैफोर्ड ने मानसिक स्वास्थ्य संबंधी चिंताओं का हवाला देते हुए मैनचेस्टर सिटी छोड़कर गर्मी की ट्रांसफर विंडो में लीड्स यूनाइटेड में शामिल होने का फैसला समझाया है। ट्रैफोर्ड ने मैनचेस्टर सिटी में पिछले सीजन में खेल न पाने के अपने अनुभव को "भयानक" बताया, जो शीर्ष क्लब में सीमित खेल समय के मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रभाव को दर्शाता है। उनका प्रस्थान पेशेवर खेलों में मानसिक सुस्थता के महत्व और शीर्ष स्तरीय क्लबों में स्थिति के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करते समय खिलाड़ियों के सामने आने वाली चुनौतियों को उजागर करता है। लीड्स में यह कदम ट्रैफोर्ड के करियर के लिए एक नई शुरुआत का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

sports.title: Non-league's greatest giant-killers eye another scalp
sports.summary: Non-league club Altrincham is preparing to face Notts County in the FA Cup, aiming to add another notable scalp to their impressive record of giant-killing achievements. Altrincham has established themselves as English football's ultimate giant-killers, having previously defeated 17 higher-league opponents in the competition. A victory over Notts County would mark their 18th such triumph, further cementing their legendary status in FA Cup history. The match represents an opportunity for the non-league side to continue their remarkable tradition of defeating more established clubs.
sports.title_hi: नॉन-लीग के सबसे बड़े विशाल-हत्यारे एक और शिकार की नजर रखे हुए हैं
sports.summary_hi: नॉन-लीग क्लब अल्ट्रिंचम एफए कप में नॉट्स काउंटी का सामना करने की तैयारी कर रहा है, जिसका लक्ष्य अपनी प्रभावशाली विशाल-हत्या उपलब्धियों के रिकॉर्ड में एक और उल्लेखनीय शिकार जोड़ना है। अल्ट्रिंचम ने अंग्रेजी फुटबॉल के अंतिम विशाल-हत्यारे के रूप में खुद को स्थापित किया है, जिन्होंने पहले प्रतियोगिता में 17 उच्च-लीग विरोधियों को हराया है। नॉट्स काउंटी पर जीत उनकी 18वीं ऐसी जीत होगी, जो एफए कप के इतिहास में उनकी किंवदंती स्थिति को और मजबूत करेगी। यह मुकाबला नॉन-लीग पक्ष के लिए अधिक स्थापित क्लबों को हराने की अपनी उल्लेखनीय परंपरा को जारी रखने का एक अवसर है।

cricket.title: Mohammed Shami retires from Test cricket
cricket.summary: Indian fast bowler Mohammed Shami announced his retirement from Test cricket after a 13-year career, exactly 13 years after his debut against West Indies in 2013. The 36-year-old finishes with 229 wickets from 64 Tests, making him the sixth-most successful fast bowler for India. Shami will continue playing white-ball formats. Former captain Mohammed Azharuddin praised his contributions and urged the BCCI to utilize his expertise for coaching the next generation of Indian pacers, marking the end of an illustrious Test career.
cricket.title_hi: मोहम्मद शमी ने टेस्ट क्रिकेट से संन्यास लिया
cricket.summary_hi: भारतीय तेज गेंदबाज मोहम्मद शमी ने 13 साल के करियर के बाद टेस्ट क्रिकेट से संन्यास की घोषणा की है, जो 2013 में वेस्टइंडीज के खिलाफ अपने डेब्यू के ठीक 13 साल बाद है। 36 वर्षीय शमी 64 टेस्ट मैचों में 229 विकेट के साथ समाप्त होते हैं, जिससे वह भारत के छठे सबसे सफल तेज गेंदबाज बन गए हैं। शमी श्वेत-पत्र प्रारूपों में खेलना जारी रखेंगे। पूर्व कप्तान मोहम्मद अजहरुद्दीन ने उनके योगदान की प्रशंसा की और भारतीय गेंदबाजों की अगली पीढ़ी को प्रशिक्षण देने के लिए उनकी विशेषज्ञता का उपयोग करने के लिए बीसीसीआई से आग्रह किया, जो एक शानदार टेस्ट करियर का अंत है।

cricket.title: Usman Khawaja exposes sandpaper details from 2018, claims entire team knew
cricket.summary: Usman Khawaja has made explosive allegations in his upcoming autobiography, claiming that the entire Australian team knew about the ball-tampering scandal during the 2018 Cape Town Test, not just Steve Smith, David Warner, and Cameron Bancroft as previously established. Khawaja states he was never interviewed by Cricket Australia about the incident. The allegations have prompted Cricket Australia to defend their original investigation findings, while the revelations have sparked significant controversy eight years after the sandpapergate scandal, with fans and officials responding to the bombshell claims.
cricket.title_hi: उस्मान ख़ावाजा ने 2018 के सैंडपेपर विवरण को उजागर किया, दावा किया कि पूरी टीम जानती थी
cricket.summary_hi: उस्मान ख़ावाजा ने अपनी आने वाली आत्मकथा में विस्फोटक आरोप लगाए हैं, दावा करते हुए कि 2018 के केप टाउन टेस्ट के दौरान गेंद-छेड़छाड़ के घोटाले के बारे में पूरी ऑस्ट्रेलियाई टीम जानती थी, न कि केवल स्टीव स्मिथ, डेविड वार्नर और कैमरून बैनक्रॉफ्ट जैसा पहले स्थापित किया गया था। ख़ावाजा का कहना है कि उनसे क्रिकेट ऑस्ट्रेलिया द्वारा इस घटना के बारे में कभी साक्षात्कार नहीं लिया गया। आरोपों ने क्रिकेट ऑस्ट्रेलिया को अपनी मूल जांच के निष्कर्षों का बचाव करने के लिए प्रेरित किया है, जबकि खुलासे ने सैंडपेपरगेट घोटाले के आठ साल बाद महत्वपूर्ण विवाद को जन्म दिया है, प्रशंसकों और अधिकारियों ने इन विस्फोटक दावों का जवाब दिया है।

cricket.title: India go 2-0 up after narrow DLS win in low-scoring suspenser
cricket.summary: India defeated New Zealand in the second ODI through a narrow Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method victory in a thrilling low-scoring encounter. The match saw 15 wickets fall to quick bowlers with only 247 runs scored across both innings, providing plenty of excitement despite the absence of an outright result. The victory gives India a 2-0 series lead. India bowling coach Morne Morkel acknowledged the team's struggles in white-ball cricket outside India and emphasized the importance of this New Zealand tour as an opportunity to improve their overseas performance.
cricket.title_hi: भारत ने कम स्कोर वाले रोमांचक मैच में डीएलएस जीत से 2-0 की बढ़त बनाई
cricket.summary_hi: भारत ने दूसरे वनडे में न्यूजीलैंड को डकवर्थ-लुईस-स्टर्न (डीएलएस) पद्धति से संकीर्ण जीत दर्ज की, जो एक रोमांचक कम-स्कोर वाली मुठभेड़ थी। मैच में दोनों पारियों में केवल 247 रन बनाए गए, जिसमें तेज गेंदबाजों के कारण 15 विकेट गिरे, जिससे स्पष्ट परिणाम की अनुपस्थिति के बावजूद बहुत उत्साह मिला। यह जीत भारत को सीरीज में 2-0 की बढ़त देती है। भारत के बॉलिंग कोच मोर्ने मोर्केल ने भारत के बाहर श्वेत-पत्र क्रिकेट में टीम के संघर्ष को स्वीकार किया और न्यूजीलैंड दौरे के महत्व पर जोर दिया, जो विदेशों में उनके प्रदर्शन में सुधार का एक अवसर है।

cricket.title: Hridoy's historic 242* powers Bangladesh's epic turnaround in Sylhet
cricket.summary: Bangladesh achieved a remarkable turnaround in their Test match against West Indies, with Jaya Hridoy scoring an unbeaten 242 runs to power the team from a precarious position of 184 for 7 to a total of 386. Despite Shadman Islam not batting, Bangladesh managed to secure a 30-run first-innings lead against the West Indies. The innings demonstrated exceptional batting resilience and individual brilliance from Hridoy, who played a crucial role in Bangladesh's recovery and gaining the advantage in the match at Sylhet.
cricket.title_hi: हृदय के ऐतिहासिक 242* ने सिलहट में बांग्लादेश के शानदार पलटवार को शक्ति दी
cricket.summary_hi: बांग्लादेश ने वेस्टइंडीज के खिलाफ अपने टेस्ट मैच में एक उल्लेखनीय पलटवार हासिल किया, जय हृदय ने 184 विकेट 7 के नाजुक स्थिति से टीम को 386 के कुल तक ले जाने के लिए 242 रन अपराजित बनाए। शदमान इस्लाम के बल्ले न उतरने के बावजूद, बांग्लादेश ने वेस्टइंडीज के खिलाफ 30 रन की पहली पारी की बढ़त हासिल की। यह पारी हृदय की असाधारण बल्लेबाजी लचीलापन और व्यक्तिगत प्रतिभा का प्रदर्शन था, जिन्होंने सिलहट में बांग्लादेश की वापसी और मैच में लाभ हासिल करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

cricket.title: Ali Usman, Abdullah Fazal removed from Pakistan Test squad
cricket.summary: Pakistan has made significant changes to their Test squad for the two-match series against Sri Lanka, removing Ali Usman and Abdullah Fazal. The selectors have brought in uncapped duo Ali Shabbir and Saqib Khan, along with experienced players Aamer Jamal and Tayyab Arif. These squad adjustments reflect Pakistan's strategic approach to the upcoming Test series, introducing fresh talent while maintaining experienced options. The changes suggest the team management's confidence in the new players to contribute effectively in the Test format against Sri Lanka.
cricket.title_hi: अली उस्मान और अब्दुल्ला फजल को पाकिस्तान टेस्ट स्क्वाड से हटाया गया
cricket.summary_hi: पाकिस्तान ने श्रीलंका के खिलाफ दो मैचों की सीरीज के लिए अपने टेस्ट स्क्वाड में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव किए हैं, अली उस्मान और अब्दुल्ला फजल को हटाया है। चयनकर्ताओं ने अनुभवहीन जोड़ी अली शब्बीर और साकिब खान को लाया है, साथ ही अनुभवी खिलाड़ी आमिर जमाल और तैयब आरिफ को भी शामिल किया है। ये स्क्वाड समायोजन आने वाली टेस्ट सीरीज के प्रति पाकिस्तान के रणनीतिक दृष्टिकोण को दर्शाते हैं, नई प्रतिभा का परिचय देते हुए अनुभवी विकल्पों को बनाए रखते हैं। ये बदलाव टीम प्रबंधन के श्रीलंका के खिलाफ टेस्ट प्रारूप में प्रभावी ढंग से योगदान देने के लिए नए खिलाड़ियों में आत्मविश्वास का सुझाव देते हैं।

usa_stock.title: This market signal called the tech selloff. Now it's sending another warning.
usa_stock.summary: Stock correlations have recently hit record lows, indicating that individual stocks are moving independently rather than in tandem. Historically, such extreme divergence tends to revert to the mean, which market analysts warn could signal trouble ahead for equities. This technical indicator previously preceded the recent technology sector selloff and is now flashing caution signals again. The reversion to normal correlation patterns could indicate increased market volatility or broader weakness as investors reassess valuations and positioning across different stock categories.

usa_stock.title: The S&P 500 could be dangerously exposed to AI. Here are some simple alternatives.
usa_stock.summary: The S&P 500 index has become heavily concentrated in artificial intelligence-related stocks, reducing its diversification despite its reputation as a broad market benchmark. This concentration creates significant risk exposure to the AI sector, which has experienced substantial volatility recently. Analysts suggest that investors seeking broader market exposure should consider alternative index strategies that provide more balanced sector representation. The large-cap index's heavy weighting toward AI stocks means that sector-specific downturns could disproportionately impact overall portfolio performance for investors relying solely on the S&P 500.

usa_stock.title: AI stocks halt their brutal, worldwide sell-off as Wall Street trims its loss for the week
usa_stock.summary: Artificial intelligence stocks rebounded on Friday after experiencing a severe global selloff over the previous two days, allowing Wall Street to recover some losses from the week. The broader U.S. stock market remained mixed as investors processed the implications of Democrats' sweeping victories in midterm elections for the economy and corporate policy. The volatile trading week reflected uncertainty about how political changes might affect business conditions, particularly in technology and AI sectors. The Friday recovery provided temporary relief but underscored ongoing market uncertainty regarding valuations and economic direction.

usa_stock.title: Here are the 2027 capital-gains tax rates for each income level
usa_stock.summary: The Internal Revenue Service has released the official capital-gains tax rates that will apply to different income levels in 2027, providing crucial information for investors planning their tax strategies. Understanding these rates is essential for making informed decisions about when to realize gains or losses on investment positions. The timing of stock sales and portfolio rebalancing can significantly impact after-tax returns, making this information particularly relevant as investors approach year-end planning. Taxpayers across various income brackets should review the updated rates to optimize their investment strategies and minimize tax liability in the coming year.

usa_stock.title: Oracle Stock Plunges 8.8% on US$20bn Capital Raise Plans
usa_stock.summary: Oracle shares declined 8.8% following the company's announcement of plans to raise $20 billion for artificial intelligence infrastructure investments. The significant stock price drop reflects investor concerns about the company's mounting debt levels and its reliance on partnerships with OpenAI for AI capabilities. The capital raise signals Oracle's commitment to competing in the AI infrastructure space but raises questions about the sustainability of its financial structure and competitive positioning. The market reaction suggests skepticism about whether the company's AI strategy and debt levels justify the investment required to maintain competitiveness in this rapidly evolving sector.

ai.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
ai.summary: A MIT Technology Review journalist experienced a new humanoid robot cleaning service in San Francisco, providing firsthand perspective on emerging robotics technology. The article documents the practical application of humanoid robots in residential settings, marking a significant milestone in bringing advanced robotics into everyday consumer services. This development represents a tangible step toward integrating autonomous machines into household tasks, demonstrating both the technological capabilities and real-world viability of humanoid robots for commercial cleaning applications.

ai.title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
ai.summary: Texas has been the fastest-growing data center market in the US and the primary location for major tech companies' AI infrastructure investments. However, recent midterm election results showing Democratic victories in key races may jeopardize this position. The political shift could impact energy policies and regulatory environments that have made Texas attractive for data center development, potentially affecting the state's role as the epicenter of America's AI infrastructure expansion and raising questions about future tech investment patterns.

ai.title: Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage
ai.summary: As AI agents become increasingly deployed in enterprise environments, data security and governance present significant challenges. The article examines scenarios where multiple AI agents autonomously access and process data from various sources without human oversight, creating potential vulnerabilities. Data lineage—tracking the origin and flow of information through systems—emerges as a critical security mechanism for enterprises deploying autonomous AI agents. This addresses growing concerns about maintaining control, accuracy, and security when AI systems operate independently across complex organizational data ecosystems.

ai.title: Agility Robotics' Nasdaq debut invites scrutiny of humanoid robot market
ai.summary: Agility Robotics, a leading US company in humanoid robot deployment, has gone public on the Nasdaq stock exchange. This milestone marks significant investor confidence in the commercial viability of humanoid robotics technology. The public offering brings increased scrutiny to the broader humanoid robot market, raising questions about valuations, practical applications, and the timeline for widespread adoption. The debut reflects growing momentum in robotics commercialization while inviting critical examination of market maturity and realistic deployment prospects.

ai.title: Google: Schools can keep search while skipping Gemini, but AI search is non-negotiable
ai.summary: Google is offering schools limited choices regarding AI tool adoption, allowing them to maintain search access while declining Gemini AI services. However, the company positions AI-powered search as mandatory, effectively limiting genuine optionality for educational institutions. This approach reflects Google's strategy to integrate AI capabilities into core products while presenting the appearance of choice. The policy raises concerns about institutional autonomy in technology adoption and the increasing difficulty for organizations to avoid AI integration in essential digital services.

quantum.title: A Strange Quantum Theorem Has Killed Einstein's Reality
quantum.summary: Albert Einstein spent decades defending classical notions of reality against quantum mechanics' counterintuitive implications. Recent research continues to challenge his foundational arguments through novel quantum theorems. These developments suggest that the everyday understanding of reality—where objects possess definite properties independent of observation—may be fundamentally incompatible with quantum theory. Researchers investigating Einstein's proposed solutions keep discovering logical inconsistencies and mathematical contradictions. This ongoing work deepens the philosophical implications of quantum mechanics, suggesting that reality at the quantum scale operates under principles radically different from our intuitive classical experience.

quantum.title: Is There Anything Left in the Dream of Cold Fusion?
quantum.summary: Cold fusion research, once dismissed after failed 1989 experiments, continues as an active research program exploring exotic atoms and unconventional physics. While modern cold fusion research won't solve the global energy crisis, it remains scientifically valuable for pushing the boundaries of physics understanding. Researchers are investigating phenomena involving exotic atomic configurations that challenge conventional physics models. This work represents a shift from seeking practical energy solutions toward fundamental scientific exploration. The persistence of cold fusion research demonstrates how failed scientific endeavors can evolve into legitimate fields that expand theoretical knowledge, even without delivering the originally promised technological breakthroughs.

quantum.title: How Do You Take a Picture of a Black Hole?
quantum.summary: Astrophysicist Shep Doeleman explains the groundbreaking achievement of capturing the first black hole image, which required coordinating a global network of telescopes functioning as a single Earth-sized instrument. This unprecedented observational feat combined radio telescopes worldwide to achieve the necessary resolution for imaging black hole shadows. Beyond static images, researchers now aim to create dynamic movies of black holes, requiring even more sophisticated coordination and data processing capabilities. The technical challenges involve synchronizing observations across continents and processing enormous datasets. This progression from still images to video represents the next frontier in black hole astronomy, enabling scientists to observe dynamic phenomena around these extreme cosmic objects in real time.

quantum.title: Stanford team confirms at Physical Superintelligence's proof of quantum speedup limits
quantum.summary: A research team at Physical Superintelligence (PSI) using an Anthropic AI model has proven the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, resolving a fundamental question in quantum computing that remained open for nearly two decades. This mathematical proof establishes theoretical limits on quantum computational speedup—the advantage quantum computers can achieve over classical computers for specific problems. The conjecture's resolution has significant implications for understanding the fundamental capabilities and constraints of quantum computing. This achievement demonstrates the emerging role of advanced AI systems in solving complex mathematical problems in theoretical computer science. The proof provides crucial theoretical foundations for assessing realistic expectations about quantum computing's practical advantages.

quantum.title: A New Map of 'Empty' Space Challenges a Tranquil Picture of the Galaxy
quantum.summary: Advanced three-dimensional mapping technologies are revealing that the interstellar medium—the gas and dust between stars traditionally treated as static background—exhibits dynamic and complex behavior. For decades, astronomers largely ignored the interstellar medium's active properties, focusing instead on stars and galaxies. New mapping initiatives demonstrate that this supposedly empty space contains significant structure, motion, and interactions that influence galactic evolution. These discoveries reshape our understanding of how the galaxy functions as an interconnected system. The interstellar medium's dynamic nature affects star formation, cosmic ray propagation, and galactic magnetic fields, making it essential for comprehensive models of galactic structure and evolution.

trump.title: Trump names Stephen Miller as new White House chief of staff
trump.summary: President Trump has appointed Stephen Miller, architect of his hard-line immigration policy, as White House chief of staff, effective Monday. Miller is considered a loyal partisan firebrand whose promotion is expected to set up likely clashes with Congress. His appointment signals Trump's continued commitment to aggressive immigration enforcement and suggests potential confrontations with the Democratic-controlled legislature over policy implementation and oversight during the remainder of Trump's term.

trump.title: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now?
trump.summary: Following significant Republican losses in recent midterm elections, the Trump coalition faces fracturing, with party members confronting a critical choice between continuing Trumpism or charting a new political direction. BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush examines the implications of these electoral setbacks for Republican strategy and identity. The analysis explores whether Republicans will maintain loyalty to Trump's political movement or pivot toward alternative leadership and policy approaches as the party reassesses its electoral viability and future positioning.

trump.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
trump.summary: The United States is offering a $20 million reward for information regarding Iran's nuclear program, reflecting escalating tensions between the two nations. President Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing military strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities. This reward initiative represents part of the Trump administration's broader strategy to pressure Iran on its nuclear development, combining intelligence-gathering incentives with explicit threats of potential military action against Iranian nuclear infrastructure.

trump.title: 'Dana, please take the job!' - Trump asks UFC boss to be White House press secretary
trump.summary: President Trump publicly offered UFC President Dana White the position of White House press secretary, which has remained vacant for weeks. The sincerity of Trump's offer remained unclear, though White later indicated willingness to travel to Washington for a meeting with the president. The unconventional appointment proposal highlights the administration's difficulty filling the high-profile communications role and reflects Trump's tendency toward unorthodox personnel decisions in staffing key White House positions.

trump.title: U.S. launches task force to disrupt Iranian ground shipping routes
trump.summary: The United States has launched a task force aimed at disrupting Iranian ground shipping routes, escalating pressure on Iran's military and economic capabilities. The initiative represents part of Trump administration efforts to contain Iranian influence and weapons proliferation. The U.S. did not specify whether military action would be involved in preventing weapons technology transfers through these routes, leaving open the possibility of direct military intervention as part of the broader strategy to confront Iranian activities in the region.

local.title: News | Melissa Schools
local.summary: The Melissa Sixth Grade Center Choir, directed by Brooke Grall and Marissa Martin, is hosting a Fall into Winter Choir Concert open to the community. This event represents the school district's ongoing commitment to engaging families and showcasing student musical talent. The concert provides an opportunity for residents to support local student performers and participate in school-sponsored cultural activities. Such events are important for building community connections and celebrating the achievements of young musicians in the Melissa Independent School District.

local.title: Melissa gas leak: Homes evacuated after gas main damaged
local.summary: A six-inch gas main was damaged by construction crews working near Melissa Road and Fannin Street on Tuesday morning, prompting emergency evacuations. Residents in the 2600 and 2700 blocks of McKinney Street and the Villages of Melissa were ordered to evacuate as emergency crews responded to the incident. The evacuation was being held as crews worked to address the damaged gas infrastructure. This incident highlights the risks associated with construction activities near critical utility lines and the importance of emergency response protocols in protecting public safety during infrastructure emergencies.
